scope: Consumed native/structural evidence and source snapshot verified; other stages and Git commit ownership require the separate full-run verifier.

cost_audit_limitations: SVD/reconstruction work and retained bytes are recomputed from saved artifacts and logs.
Aggregate diagnostic counters are checked in sums; clustering is not rerun and diagnostic operations were not individually traced.
Historical elapsed times and floating-point prequantization SVD errors cannot be independently remeasured by a read-only audit.
